The '''2000–01''' season of the [[Belgian First Division A|Jupiler League]] began on August 12, 2000, and ended on May 20, 2001.  [[RSC Anderlecht|Anderlecht]] became champions.

These teams were promoted from the [[Belgian Second Division|second division]] at the start of the season:
*[[R. Antwerp F.C.|Antwerp]] (second division champion)
*[[R.A.A. Louviéroise|Louviéroise]] (playoff winner)

==Relegated teams==
These teams were relegated to the second division at the end of the season:
*[[K.R.C. Zuid-West-Vlaanderen|Harelbeke]]
*[[Y.R. K.V. Mechelen|KV Mechelen]]
